facts.fact: POTRAZ says the African Union Commission awarded it a USD 200,000 grant in 2015 under the AU Regional Internet Exchanges Initiative to set up the Harare Regional Internet Exchange Point; the grantor is the AU, no other country is named.

POTRAZ says in its 2020 forum contribution that HIX needs to attract more regional players to connect and peer to become a proper regional IXP, and that all connected members are access providers with two international peers (Packet Clearing House, Quad9); the document is undated, so the forum opening date is used.
